archetype: Archetype 4: Swiss & High-Contrast (Adapted for Modern Minimal POS)

layout.spacing: Generous spacing. Screen padding p-4 or p-6. Container gap-4 to gap-6.
layout.border_radius: rounded-2xl for main cards, rounded-xl for buttons and inputs.
layout.shadows: Minimalist. shadow-sm for cards, shadow-md for sticky header or floating elements.
layout.grid: Mobile-first bento grid. grid-cols-2 gap-4. Primary action (Kasir) col-span-2.

components.buttons: Shadcn standard. h-12 for better mobile touch targets. font-medium.
components.inputs: Shadcn input, h-12. rounded-xl. focus:ring-2 focus:ring-slate-900.
components.cards: Flat design, border border-slate-200, bg-white, no heavy shadows.
components.header: Sticky top, backdrop-blur-md bg-white/80, z-50, border-b border-slate-200.

login_register.description: Minimalist form. No ad images. Tabs for Login vs Register. Register has toggle for Owner vs Employee (Join via 18-char ID).

dashboard.header: Displays Workshop Name (H2), User Name (body), Role (small badge).
dashboard.menu_grid: Grid with main actions. Kasir (col-span-2), Transaksi, Barang, Bengkel, Pengguna.
dashboard.system_section: Placed at the bottom of the dashboard menu list. Contains Settings and Logout (destructive).

cashier.description: Fast POS entry. Search/Scan item, quick quantity adjust, total calculation, checkout button.

inventory.description: List of items with stock. Add/Edit/Delete actions.

workshop_details.description: Info about workshop. Crucially: Section for Admin to approve or remove employee access.

image_urls.description: Minimalist abstract lines. Use strictly as a subtle watermark or auth background if completely necessary, otherwise rely on empty space. Keep opacity very low (e.g. 5%).

accessibility_and_testing.data_testid: MANDATORY for all interactive elements (e.g., login-submit-button, menu-kasir-button).
accessibility_and_testing.touch_targets: Minimum 44x44px for mobile interaction (h-12 in Tailwind).

instructions_to_main_agent: Delete all old ad-like images from Login and Dashboard.
When employee registers, collect 18-character alphanumeric 'Workshop ID' to join.
Admin/Owner must approve employees in the 'Detail Bengkel' page before they can access the full system.
Header must strictly show Workshop Name (prominent), and User Name + Role below it.
Move Logout button to a 'Sistem' section at the bottom of the dashboard menu.
Ensure UI is mobile-first, using Tailwind and Shadcn components customized with rounded-2xl and h-12 inputs/buttons for touch.
Do NOT use 'Inter'. Use 'Outfit' for headings and 'Figtree' for body.
Keep it extremely clean: white backgrounds, slate borders, slate-900 text. No unnecessary gradients or heavy shadows.
